answer: Stop sybils with an atlas jetty signal: an agent stakes a bond for one jetty. Each cycle it sends a signal from the jetty and files it on the atlas; verifiers match the signal's echo to the atlas, voiding a jetty whose signal is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 jetties at 18x: each signal fits one jetty and one atlas, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents signal once and keep rights.
